title: A builder sign-up keeps working when the bot check is switched on: both email claims carry the Turnstile token

source.ref: Funnel and onboarding audit 2026-11-27 (project thread: Audit funnels and onboarding for Fergal; doc https://claude.ai/artifact/K6WJF8sPmATEFjjDNCr3sh)

detail: FOUND 2026-11-27: claimWithEmail (launch-your-business/actions.ts:129-132) and claimFeatureWithEmail (lib/feature-builder/actions.ts:45-48) build a fresh FormData with only email and next, then call sendSignupLink, which refuses any request without a token once NEXT_PUBLIC_TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY is set (app/sign-in/actions.ts:206-207). Neither claim form (create-space-claim.tsx, feature-studio.tsx) renders <BotCheck>. The key is not set in production yet (checked 2026-11-27), and the owner approved switching it on (2026-11-26), so the first day it is set every Launch Your Business, Create a Space, Free Spotlight, website and email builder sign-up fails. The RUNBOOKS switch-on test only checks /sign-in. Fix: render BotCheck on both claim forms and forward BOT_CHECK_FIELD into the send. Must land before the site key goes into Vercel.

verify.note: Passes once the consequence in the title holds.
